decision: Reject the Q6T16 selected-down pair-reuse owner on hip_gfx1100: the env-on candidate is flat-to-negative at physical c8 (median -0.27%, overlapping ranges), so GGUF_Q6_T16_SELECTED_PAIRREUSE_MIN_ROWS stays 0 and the per-row Q6 down owner remains the default.
